commit_message:
RED-129256, Fix TOUCH command from script in no-touch mode (#13512)

When a client in no-touch mode issues a TOUCH command on a key, the
key’s access time should be updated, but in scripts, and module's
RM_Call, it isn’t updated.
Command proc should be matched to the executing client, not the current
client.

Co-authored-by: Udi Ron <udi@speedb.io>

fix_commit.message: Fix crash in lookupKey() when `executing_client` is NULL (#14415)
fix_commit.author: Moti Cohen

findings.title: NULL pointer dereference of server.executing_client in lookupKey()
findings.message: In lookupKey(), the CLIENT NO-TOUCH check was changed to use server.executing_client->cmd->proc instead of server.current_client->cmd->proc, in order to correctly detect the TOUCH command when it is invoked via scripts/RM_Call. However, the code only null-checks server.current_client before entering the branch; it never checks whether server.executing_client itself is NULL before dereferencing it. server.executing_client is NULL in several legitimate contexts, most notably when handleClientsBlockedOnKey() runs after a key-modifying command (e.g. RPUSH) unblocks a client blocked on BRPOP: the lookupKey() call performed while serving the unblocked client's read happens outside of any executing client context. If the client that owns/triggered this lookup path has CLIENT_NO_TOUCH set (server.current_client non-NULL and flagged), the code proceeds to dereference server.executing_client->cmd->proc while server.executing_client is NULL, producing a NULL pointer dereference and crashing the server.
findings.suggestion:
Guard the dereference of server.executing_client with an explicit NULL check before accessing its cmd field, and skip re-evaluating/altering the LOOKUP_NOTOUCH flag if it is already set. Only dereference server.executing_client when it is non-NULL, e.g.:

if (((flags & LOOKUP_NOTOUCH) == 0) &&
    (server.current_client && server.current_client->flags & CLIENT_NO_TOUCH) &&
    (server.executing_client && server.executing_client->cmd->proc != touchCommand))
    flags |= LOOKUP_NOTOUCH;
findings.suggestion_code:
if (((flags & LOOKUP_NOTOUCH) == 0) &&
    (server.current_client && server.current_client->flags & CLIENT_NO_TOUCH) &&
    (server.executing_client && server.executing_client->cmd->proc != touchCommand))
    flags |= LOOKUP_NOTOUCH;

ground_truth.root_cause: The fix for the TOUCH-from-script bug swapped current_client for executing_client in a dereference chain without adding the same NULL-guard that was already present for current_client. server.executing_client is not guaranteed to be set in all code paths that reach lookupKey() (notably the blocked-client unblocking path), so the missing null check leads to a NULL pointer dereference.

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: NULL pointer dereference of server.executing_client in lookupKey()
